name: OpenAI Chat Completions
summary: Use any OpenAI SDK or plain HTTP against Diffusion Router.
statusNote: The Chat Completions relay surface is exercised by Diffusion's transport test matrix.
prerequisites: A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Point OpenAI tooling at Diffusion
setup.body: The OpenAI-compatible base URL ends in /v1, exactly as SDKs expect.

restart: Open a new terminal (or re-create your SDK client) so the environment is read.

verification.title: One curl exchange
verification.body: A 200 with a completion body proves the whole path.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
413: request bodies are bounded; split very large payloads.
429: the upstream rate limit is forwarded with Retry-After — wait and retry; Diffusion never replays automatically.

removal.title: Unset the environment
removal.body: Remove the exports from your shell profile. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: No files are modified; unsetting the variables returns the SDK to its default endpoint.
